entries.final_answer: Directive is the step-2 reference slice. Directives are top-level DRG entry points (referenced by paradigms); tactics seldom are, so Directive better exercises the graph walk and relationship registration end to end.
options: Tactic (extend existing read slice with registration + relationships)
Toolguide (new kind, simplest, full add-a-kind + read + registration)
Directive (dangling existing kind, prove read wiring + registration)
entries.question: Which artefact kind should be the step-2 reference slice taken end-to-end through read + registration first?
